[[Vuosaari]], [[Helsinki]], [[Finland]] | capacity = 1,500 | coordinates = {{coord|60|13|00|N|25|08|19|E|type:landmark_region:FI}} | chairman = Jorma Koivukangas | mgrtitle = Manager | manager = | league = [[Vitonen]] | season = | position = | website = {{URL|http://www.fcviikingit.fi}} | pattern_la1=|pattern_b1=|pattern_ra1=| leftarm1=dc0000|body1=dc0000|rightarm1=dc0000|shorts1=dc0000|socks1=dc0000| pattern_la2= | pattern_b2= | pattern_ra2= | leftarm2=ffffff | body2=ffffff | rightarm2=ffffff | shorts2=000080 | socks2=000080 | }} '''FC Viikingit''' is a [[Football in Finland|Finnish]] [[association football|football]] club based in [[Vuosaari]], [[East Helsinki]], that competes in the ''[[Vitonen]]'', the sixth tier of [[Football in Finland|Finnish football]]. They play their home matches at [[Vuosaaren urheilukenttä]], also called Heteniitty. The club's name and crest refer to [[Vikings]], and they are known for their red colour. FC Viikingit played the 2007 season in the [[Veikkausliiga|Finnish premier division]] (''Veikkausliiga''), but were relegated to the ''Ykkönen'' and competed there until 2014, when they were relegated to [[Kakkonen]]. The club's reserve team, [[FC Viikkarit]], were promoted to the ''[[Kakkonen]]'' for the 2014 season but they had to give it up, because they were not able to play on the same division as the main team."}}
